title: Quality Is Low
text: Quality Is Low. You get what you pay for. The quality of these is very low. They are very thin wooden numbers that are very easily broken. The magnets are small and can pop off. Keep an eye on kids while they're using these since they will break and the kid could choke. They are bright and the kids enjoyed using them for a few times before they broke. Since they were so cheap, I don't feel disappointed in their breaking. But I likely won't buy more due to safety concerns.
